However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) WORK DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION AND SCOPE 1 Name of the work a Providing security round the clock at ANCOL Main gate nd allocation and building of ANCOL, and its surroundings

2 Work Description i. To prevent unauthorized entry in the prem ises of ANCOL and attached establishment of ANCOL ii. Unauthorized vehicles and their parking in the campus iii. Proper vehicles of the occupants of the ca mpus at appropriate area iv. To prevent parking of vehicles at unauthor ized area on the road, passages etc., v. Proper guiding of students on the road for the smooth movement of vehicles within t he campus vi. To Prevent loitering of unauthorized perso ns in the campus sitting on the culverts, b oundary walls etc., vii. To prevent pilferage / theft of the property belonging to the campus viii. To undertake any other work of similar nat ure assigned by the authorities and reporti ng to the Principal, ANCOL of any untowar d accidents in the ANCOL Building and its campus. 3 Scope The scope of the work includes security of the entire ar ea as above in order to ensure protection of all Govt. p roperty, building, vehicles, garden all types of plants a nd other Govt. Properties etc.,. The authorized officer will monitor the security guards by the contractor. 4 Miscellaneous Security to be provided by the security guard at the di scretion and satisfaction of the Principal/ Campus In-C harge of the ANCOL Sd/- (Dr. S Jayakumar) Principal, ANCOL I have read and fully understand the work description, scope, specification et c., as mentioned above. I shall get the work done accordingly by the contract secu rity guard engaged. Further, I shall obey the directive of the officials of the ANCOL establishment in the regard as applicable during the period of the contract. Signature of the tenderer/ contractor and address with seal 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS The technical bid should contain in the following: 1. The tenderer should submit PSARA License issued by the Competent Authority. 2. The participating firms should be registered with local Labour Commissioner Office. Necessary documents issu ed by Competent Authority should be furnished. 3. The tender should be accompanied with an EMD of ₹ 99,500/- (Rupees: Ninety nine thousand five hundred onl y) in the form of call deposit drawn in favour of the Principal, ANCOL, Sri Vijaya Puram. The EMD of the success ful tenderer shall be refunded on furnishing Performance Guarantee after execution of the agreement. 4. The office of the service provider must be located in the state of consignee (Document evidence of the Local e stablishment along with address, Registration details and person to be contacted should be submitted). 5. The successful tenderer should meticulously follow all the provisions notified vide Andaman & Nicobar Gazette Notification No. 22 dated 25/01/2010. 6. The tenders submitted by partnership firms should be furnished with "Partnership Deed" duly registered 7. The Principal ANCOL reserves the right to cancel / terminate the contract if the work is found unsatisfactory at any time and for that he/ she will not be bound to give explanation and his/ her decision will be final 8. The Principal ANCOL reserves the right to consider the other factors also like experience, credibility in particula r works at least for three years etc., while finalizing the tender and is not at all bound to accept lowest quoted tender. 9. This tender is for the performance for assigned services as mentioned herein by deputing appropriate personn el/ Labour and not a contract of supply of Labour. Whereas it shall be the duty and responsibility of the succes sful bidder to comply with all the laws, rules and regulations and other instructions having force of law. The coll ege would not takeany responsibility with regard to any employee of the successful bidder. It shall be the duty of successful bidder to bring to the knowledge of each and every person employed by him that the College in no way is responsible to such an employee for observance of any of provisions of labour laws but not limited t o the following: i) Code on wages 2019 ii) Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 iii) Code on Social Security, 2020 iv) Industrial Relations Code, 2020 v) Maternity Benefits (Amendment) Act 2017 vi) Contract Labour (Regulation and Abolition Act 1970) vii) All other Labour laws applicable time to time 10. The offers/ bids which are not in compliance of Minimum wages Act and any other Labour laws shall b e treated as invalid. 11. The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years should be 6,00,000/-. 12. The service required is purely on “as and when required basis" and any assignment can b e increased or decreased at any time as per the requirement of the college such as vacati on, long leave etc., and no payment will be made for the reduced period. 13. The contractors should extend the various statutory benefits like minimum wages, GST, EPF Act etc., to their personnel deployed by them under the contract.

14. The Prospective bidder is registered with the authorities concerned of Labour Department under Cont ract Labour (R&A) 1970 or any other Labour laws (wherever applicable). 15. To ensure the minimum wages are extended to the individuals the payment to the personnel is to be made by the contractor through their bank account only. All related documents on payment of wages to the personnel such as EPF, GST etc., is to be furnished to the department while submitting the bill f or the previous month for verification and passing the claim. 16. Whenever there is a revision of wages by the Andaman & Nicobar Admn., the same will b e borne by the department, no other charges will be paid by the department. 17. The contractor shall provide a supervisor to ensure proper supervision of work of who shall be availa ble to the Principal ANCOL as and when required. 18. The tender should be accompanied with an EMD of FIVE percent (5%) as mentioned in bid document i n the form of call deposit drawn in favour of the Principal, ANCOL, Sri Vijaya Puram. The EMD of the s uccessful tenderer shall be refunded on furnishing security deposit after execution of agreement. 19. The tenderer will observe necessary formalities as per provisions of the Labour Act and Principal ANC OL will not in any way be responsible for any breach of Labour Act by him/her. 20. The contractor should furnish his/her personnel information and address to the Principal ANCOL, And aman & Nicobar Administration. He/ she should always be available for contact in connection with th e assigned works. 21. The contractor shall have to maintain / ensure minimum quality of work during the contract period ot herwise the contract will be cancelled at any point of during contract period. 22. The contractor shall provide well trained Male/ Female healthy security guards preferable Ex-Service men between the ages of 18 to 45 years for ANCOL CAMPUS along with Building. 23. A daily attendance/ workbook should be maintained by the contractor will be submitted to the conce rned In-Charge on daily basis for verification and authentication. However the college shall also mai ntain attendance of the outsourcing staff. 24. The security should not have the habit of chewing pan, Tobacco etc., or should not be under the influ ence of any intoxication materials. If found under the influence of alcohol any other intoxication sub stance, appropriate legal action will be initiated against such security guard. 25. The security guard should be deputed on all the days during contract period and as per the instructio ns of the campus officer / Principal, ANCOL and the engagement of the security personnel is purely a s and when required basis. 26. Double duty of the security guard during the shift work should be avoided. 27. The identity and personal data of each security guard deputed to the college during the period of con tract should be invariably be submitted to the office within the 03 days of the receipt of the work ord er including his address, telephone number and photograph etc.,. 28. The contractor should not change the security guard frequently and without prior permission of the P rincipal ANCOL. If any change of security guard is required, prior permission should be obtained fro m the Principal with valid reason. 29. The security guard engaged by the agency shall wear proper uniform and a badge bearing his name and monogram of the security agency while on duty. The said uniform, badge and all other articles r equired for the job will be provided by the agency at their own cost. 30. The contractor should have to ensure that Security Guard placed on duty by him/ her reaches their r espective place of duty everyday in time and remains in duty till relived by his substitute for the nex t shift. His/ her absence from the place of duty will be viewed seriously and heavy penalty may be le vied against the security service Agency which may amount to Rs.1000/- per day or part thereof besi des other legal damages claimable from the security Agency. 31. All personnel to be screened by the college committee before engagement. 32. No compensation shall be paid to the security Agency or Guard for any death, injury, sustained or an y diseases caused to the security personnel while performing their duties.

33. The contractor shall not assign or sublet the awarded work to any other person or agency without pri or written approval of the Principal ANCOL. 34. For any attempt or negotiation directly on the part of the tenderer with the authority to whom he has submitted the tender to influence the Principal ANCOL by any means, the tender will be liable for exc lusion from consideration / acceptance. 35. All materials such as torch light, baton, uniform, and any other materials required for the security of t he area have to be provided by the contractor himself. 36. The principal, ANCOL will not supply manpower or materialsfor execution of work awarded. 37. If the contract security guard fails to report or carry the assigned contract work on any day at the de signated hour, the principal ANCOL reserves the right to get it done through any other agency or sec urity guard and the actual cost on account of that will be realized / recovered from the contractor. 38. All the amenities to the security personnel such as drinking water, washing facilities etc. should be pr ovided by the contractor at his own cost at the work premises as required under contract Labour (R & A) Act-1970. 39. The contractor shall be responsible for the conduct and performance of the security guard and any lo se on account of damage or theft by the security guard will be compensated by him/her to the Princi pal ANCOL. 40. While working during night and during inclement weather, the agency must take proper measures for safety of security guards as deemed fit and Principal ANCOL will not be held responsible for any casu alty. 41. The contractor shall be liable to undertake any other Govt. work related to security, parking vehicles, guiding of students and trainees inside the premises of the ANCOL establishment as assigned, by the Principal ANCOL or his authorized officer / official in this regard. 42. The security guard deputed should have undergone the security training under A & N Police and a ce rtificate to this effect should be submitted before deputing a security guard as per the Gazette Notifi cation No. 22 of 2010. He/She should also have minimum physical fitness for security guards as pres cribed in the above notification. 43. Performance Guarantee (PG): The successful and duly approved bidder shall deposit performance security equivalent to an amoun t of FIVE Percent (5 %) of the quoted bidding in the form of Bank Guarantee from a nationalized ban k or call deposit in favour of the Principal, ANCOL within 07 Days from the date of acceptance o f tender failing which the EMD will be forfeited. The bid security is required to protect Principa l, ANCOL against the risk of bidders conduct, which would warrant the security forfeited. The security deposit will be forfeited in part / whole in case of:- (i) Unsatisfactory service (ii) Theft or misappropriation of articles of college and its premises (iii) Damages caused to assets of ANCOL Sri Vijaya Puram. (iv) Withdrawal of the successful tender from the contract before its expiry. (v) Violation of any of the terms and conditions of the tender. 44. The Daily manual attendance or workbook and biometric attendance of the personnel shall be m aintained by the contractor. However, biometric attendance of the personnel shall be maintained by the college. The manual attendance should be authenticated daily by the concerned In-Charge of the college. At the end of the month, the contractor will submit the bill for the month on daily basis in trip licate with the following documents for effecting payment. (i) Xerox copy of the attendance/ workbook duly certified by the concerned authority of AN COL

(ii) Documents of payment of wages to the personnel through bank for the previous month (iii) Previous month’s EPF statement of the personnel (iv) GST statement of the previous month. 45. Contract Validity: The rates agreed upon shall be valid for one year from the date of the signing of the contract (agree ment). However, the Principal, ANCOL reserves the right to extend the period up to another three mo nths or part at the same rate and same terms and conditions. No variation in rates shall be allowed u ntil completion of the contract period except minimum wage which is revised as per A & N Ad ministration's Notification and its prospective effect on EPF contribution from the date of revision of minimum wage. 46. Dispute in Tender Finalization: In the event of any dispute arising out of finalizing the tender agreement or any other matter relating t hereto, the decision of the Principal, ANCOL shall be final and bidding on all concerned. The same will not be challenged in the court of law. 47. Disqualifying Clause: The Principal, ANCOL reserves the right to disqualify such bidder(s) who have a record of not meeting t he contractual obligations against earlier contracts entered into with Principal, ANCOL. The terms and conditions enumerated above shall be blinding and the bidders shall have to accept them in writing al ong with the tender. 48. Time limit for unforeseen claim: Under no circumstances, whatsoever, any claim for any payment/compensation from the Principal, AN COL on any account will be considered unless the contractor submits the claim in writing within a mon th from the date of the final payment of the bill for the work concerned/carried. 49. Arbitration Clause: (a) In case of any difference/ dispute arising out of between the parties, the parties shall make every ef fort to resolve the disputes amicably. (b) In case of failure, the dispute/ differences whatsoever arising out of this Agreement between the p arties, the same shall be referred for Arbitration to a Sole Arbitrator, who shall be appointed by the Se cretary (Education), A&N Administration, in Sri Vijaya Puram. The Arbitration proceeding shall be held at terms of the provisions of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act 1996 and Amendments made therein f rom time to time. The Arbitrator appointed under this clause shall pass the award within a period of 06 (six) months from the date of reference made to him. The award of such Arbitration shall be final and binding upon the parties. (c) The Court in Sri Vijaya Puram shall have exclusive jurisdiction in all disputes. 50. Price Variation:

The Principal, ANCOL shall not be responsible for any escalation of cost of material or Labour whatsoev er or any increase in any duty/levis or taxes on any account and the contractor's rate and contractor's obligation shall remain unaltered by such escalation during the period of contract except minimum wa ges. 51. Any further dispute shall be subject to jurisdiction of the courts at Sri Vijaya Puram. Sd/- (Dr. S Jayakumar) Principal, ANCOL .
